editionLabel: Repos Production Just One English refreshed rulebook (2025)
firstPlayerRule: Randomly choose a player to be the first active player. That player draws the first card while the others write clues.
clarifications: At the end of each round, the player to the active player's left becomes the new active player.
interpretation: The random selection names the first guesser, while the other players act as clue writers in that round.
